description: This Java enum defines various HTTP headers used within the Ditto gateway security module, providing utility methods to retrieve headers by name and list all headers.

classes.name: HttpHeader
classes.description: An enumeration of HTTP headers used in the gateway security context, including utility methods for header lookup.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the HttpHeader matching the given string, if any.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name associated with this HttpHeader enum value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this HttpHeader.
